verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents a public API with token-based API key auth that can perform anything doable in the UI (configure integrations, define incidents, set up webhooks), plus a CLI (fhcli) and webhook support for CI/orchestration integration. This is a documented, first-party API reference used for driving the product programmatically. Missing for 10: an accessible machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi probe returned 404s) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness/rate limits.
